strings.hintAdd: Lundapo ishina lya cipe pa kufisa ubushininkisho bwa cibombelo kuli ci. Icakumwenako: com.netflix.mediaclient
strings.hintLog: Ifunde lyonse lyafimbwa mu nshita ya kupwisha — icipe te kuti cibe icakosa. Ukulemba kwapelela kuli failo imofye: /data/adb/tricky_store/target.txt

strings.mdKbSmart: • Ukusenda akabokoshi ka fipe ukwa mano: kulaceeceeta akabokoshi ka fipe aka nomba ukulingana no mulongo wa Google uwa kufumyapo (CRL) no kwesha intuntuko ishingi ukufikila yasanga akabokoshi ka fipe akalinga, no kusunga ukwaibela no kutendeka cipya cipya imilimo ya Google. Ici cibomba pali cila tap kabili cilekabila intaneti (amaminiti 1-3).
strings.mdKbNet: • Akabokoshi ka fishinka ukufuma ku cifulo ca kufimbilikisha: apoka akabokoshi ka fishinka ukufuma ku cifulo ca kufimbilikisha icaishibikwa (GitHub) no kucisunga ku /data/adb/tricky_store/keybox.xml. Kafwaya intaneti kabili cilatwala amaminiti 1-3. Ibomfiwa ilyo ukuleta kwa mano kwafilwa nangu ilyo akabokoshi ka fifungulo kapilibulwa ku minwe.
strings.mdRkpDiag: • RKP ukufwailisha: ukuceeceeta ifiputulwa fya kupeela ifishinka fya kutali ifyasangwa, ukuceeceeta umusango wa citupa ca kushininkisha, no kulanga umusango wa cibombelo ca KmInstallKeybox. Tacipilibula nangu cimo — ukumona kwa cibombelo ukwalinga.
strings.mdWvDiag: • Ukuceceta (ukubelenga fye): kulalanga ifilangililo fya mulingo () ukufuma ku fipe fya kufimbapo, ukusangwa kwa failo ya kufimbapo iya DRM (IDM), ne mibele ya mibombele iyapalana. Tacipilibula nangu cimo.
strings.mdRkpManual: • Manual RKP fix: runs sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh manual. Fixes attestation issues when the automatic pass fails. Every run prints a clear success/failure line.
strings.mdRkpFull: • Ukulungika ukwakumanina: ukubomba sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh ukwakumanina. Ukubombela pa milandu iyakosa kabili ukutwala inshita iikalamba. Icafumamo icaumfwika cilemoneka pa mpela.
strings.mdGmsReset: • Ukubweseshamo GMS: ukufumyapo Play Store na Google imilimo (GMS+GSF) amashiwi no kutendeka cipya cipya icipe. Pakushininkisha fye ukwakosa — tacikuma ifikope fyenu nangu amafailo yenu.
strings.mdCertify: • Ukushininkisha kwa kutamba: kulaceeceeta RKP icitupa ca kushininkisha umusango wa cibombelo no kubwesha imibele ya kushininkisha nga cakabilwa. Tacikuma ku fyebo fya babomfya.
strings.mdSoter: • Ukuwamya: ukuwamya ifintu ifikuma ku kushininkisha kwa fibombelo. Ukubomfiwa ku fibombelo fimo ifishintilila pa SOTER ukucila pa Kutamba Ubufumacumi.
strings.mdPifApply: • Ukubomfya PIF: ukubutuka sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/apply_pif.sh amaka. Ukubomfya ifishibilo fya minwe ifyasalilwe (ifya mu ncende/ifya pa muulu) no kulungika amafailo pif.prop/pif.json. Icasangwa icaumfwika cilemoneka mu citabo.
strings.mdPifCheck: • PIF ukuceeceeta: kulalanga umusango wa injini iyabikwa, amafailo ya fishibilo fya minwe (custom.pif.prop/pif.prop), ne fitabo. Moneni fye — tacipilibula nangu cimo.
strings.mdCanary: • Ukuwamya kwa ciKana: ukubomba sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/falcon_update_pif.sh -m. Ukubuula Injini ya Canary iya nomba line iya kushininkisha ukulingana ne fitupa fya RKP ifyacindama (Ukubelenga 2026).
strings.mdEngineDiag: • Ukupima kwa injini: kulaceeceeta umusango wa TrickyStoreOSS (pid, ifitabo), amafailo ya cibokoshi ca fishinte (ifyabomba vs umubomfi), ifishibilo fya minwe ifya cine cine vs ifya bufi, ifishinte. Ukulanga fye ukufwailisha.
strings.hintKbSlots: Iciputulwa citungulula ififulo fibili ifya fibokoshi: ica kubalilapo (ica mushilo, icabula ukufuuta) ne ca bubili (ica kusunga). Iyi tab ilangisha icifulo icilebomba, ukupilibula ifyo ulefwaya, nangu ukutungilila ica bubili ukufika ku ca kubalilapo pa kwipusha ukwasokoloka — ne fya kusunga ne citabo conse.
strings.mdIntegrityDiag: • Ukupima ubufumacumi: ukuceeceeta TEE ukuleta kwa cishibilo, ukubika kwa laibulale mu kati ka cishibilo2, umusango wa kufumyapo (CRL), ukucingililwa-umutande wa kucingililwa no RKP umusango. Ukubelenga fye — takwalula nangu cimo.
strings.confirmIntegrityFix:
🔧 Ukubomfya na kabili ukwacingililwa:

• Umutande wa bucingililo wapangilwa cipya cipya ukufuma kuli cila app iyabikwa.
• Iciputulwa ca kubomfya-ROM icalinga cibomfiwa na kabili. ukutendeka nakabili.##
Tapali icafumiishiwapo kabili akabokoshi ka fikomo aka kubalilapo takwakumapo.

Ukukonkanyapo?
strings.mdKbSlots: • Amabokoshi ya fibokoshi: yalanga imibele ya fifulo fya kubalilapo ne fya bubili kabili ilapilibula ifyo mulefwaya pa kati ka fiko. Ica kubalilapo (/data/adb/falcon/keybox.xml) lyonse cilacingililwa kabili tacafuutapo. Ukusumbula ica bubili ukufika ku ca kubalilapo kufwaya ukushininkisha ukwasokoloka.
strings.confirmKbSlotsPromote:
⬆️ Ukusumbula icifulo ca bubili ku ca kubalilapo:

• /data/adb/falcon/keybox2.xml ciba ica kubalilapo ica mu kati.
